The Kalpasar Project is one of India's most ambitious proposed megaprojects, designed to transform part of the Gulf of Khambhat into a massive freshwater reservoir. The Gujarat government plans to construct a 60.13-kilometre dyke between Bhavnagar and Bharuch, including approximately 26.7 kilometres directly across the sea.
